subject.title: fix(scripts): warn when postinstall detects running gateway with stale module imports

question: Should OpenClaw accept an npm postinstall loopback TCP probe plus `OPENCLAW_DISABLE_POSTINSTALL_RESTART_WARNING` as a warning-only mitigation for stale gateway imports?
rationale: The code-level blockers appear fixed, but install-time probing and a new operator env flag are product and compatibility choices that automation should not approve on its own.

options.title: Accept Postinstall Advisory
options.body: Merge this as defense-in-depth after maintainer review, while keeping the linked stale-gateway issue open for full recovery behavior.

options.title: Use Update/Runtime Layer Only
options.body: Pause or close this PR if maintainers want the warning or recovery to live only in update CLI or runtime stale-import handling.

options.title: Require Broader Live Proof
options.body: Ask for an end-to-end package update or rollback proof with a running gateway before accepting any postinstall detection path.

recommendation.title: Accept Postinstall Advisory
recommendation.body: Merge this as defense-in-depth after maintainer review, while keeping the linked stale-gateway issue open for full recovery behavior.
